notes.title: Supermodel Monsters Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43189054/2cb457e82cde457b809bf191b1d0ce2e53a07ac4.png
There are some juicy updates here including a new fast-paced track, a way to have your very own real monster shipped to your home, plus some quality-of-life enhancements with full game controller support and improved custom party mode hosting.

New track: "Sasquatch Summit"
Wind your way up a snow-clad mountain peak in this point to point race featuring pine trees and dangerous rock walls and the odd patch of ice on the road. Keep a lookout for Bigfoot - we’ve seen him skulking in the trees.

Order a Custom Monster Model!
We’ve been working with our friends at IGC (In Game Collectables) to integrate the ability to order your very own customised monster as a high-quality 3D Resin printed model. When you are in the Monster Customiser you’ll be able to select ‘Get This Monster Model’ to place an order. Customise your monster and use the special introductory price to get your monster shipped straight to your door. We have several of these in the office and they are very cool!

Full Controller Support
Game controllers are now fully supported throughout the game menus and wider user interface where previously they were only available during the race.

New hosting setup for Custom Party mode
We’ve updated the way Custom races are hosted in Party Mode. These are now all hosted on our dedicated servers providing much improved consistency of play and ping times. Enjoy! 

Happy trails!

notes.title: Need For Speed Update
notes.notes:
This release includes large optimisations to the GPU performance of the game, which should help the game run smoothly on most people’s machines. We hope you feel the speed!

Also in this release:

 Many players have mentioned they enjoy the carnage in MRL but find it just a bit too chaotic. To help with this we’ve changed the max number of players in a race to eight, which in our playtesting helped a lot. We’d love to hear how you find this change.
 Added the ability to change monsters between races
 Mines now have a red glow coming out of them, to make them easier to see
 Cars are now better at staying aligned with the track when taking jumps
 UX improvements to the monster customisation screen
 Improved support for non-English player names on leaderboards

Oh and one more thing… watch out for a new track coming your way soon!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43189054/d36fa6fd644c47ce156568450ae1ab1a2de9c6a8.png

notes.title: Let’s Get This Party Started! Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=8HisXAKwYO4;full][/previewyoutube]
Who likes to party? Your monsters! In this update we've added Party Mode to help you create and join parties for online and private races.

Every monster knows that Monster Racing League is awesome when you’re playing with friends so we’ve made it even easier to find and play with all of your monster pals with our new Party Mode! You can create a party and share the code with your friends so they can easily join you. Then your whole party can play online against other monsters or play privately by yourselves - we don’t mind!

Here are the changes:

 Added new Party Mode with online and private game support.
 Removed previous host/join button from main menu.
 Enabled more time for monsters to emote before and after a race.
 Added destructible bones to T-Wrecks bridges. No more jumpy deathy crashy.
 Added blue tint to the player name above your car.
 Updated various onboarding messages.
 Loads of fixes, graphics and quality optimisation in all tracks.
 Improved networking when players leave during a match.
 Added ZOMBIE to players who leave during a race.
 Lots of networking tweaks.
 Various engine updates.
 Various bugfixes and tweaks.

Ahh, so what are you waiting for? Create your monster party and get racing to glory and beyond! We’d love to hear about your happy fun times party so jump onto the MRL Discord server and let everyone know where the best parties are happening: Monster Racing League Discord Server

Party on!

notes.title: A Monster Of An Update – Monster Racing League Is Now Free!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Mzk8PUeTF4Y;full][/previewyoutube]
We know that Monster Racing League is the most fun when you’re playing with friends so we’re removing as many barriers as possible to getting your friends to join the game. That’s why from today Monster Racing League is completely free!

Ignition Race Pass
To coincide with this release we’re introducing the Ignition Race Pass. It’s a 100-tier battle pass with a huge range of unlocks. Unlock monsters with unique ability and booster loadouts, or new helmets, masks and other cosmetics, and equip them in the new monster customiser. 

The Race Pass is free but you can purchase the Premium Pass to unleash over 80 additional unlockable items. Stand out from the crowd with premium cosmetics and unlock monsters with powerful abilities and boosters faster! Unlike many battle passes there’s no time limit on completing it so you’re free to progress through it at your own pace.

Existing Players
A big thank you to all our existing players, your support and feedback during Early Access is invaluable. In recognition of your support all existing players will automatically get the Ignition Premium Pass for free. If you have any issues accessing this just let us know and we’ll get you sorted.

New Track and DLC!
To celebrate the release we’re introducing the new high-altitude Cliff Hangar track and three new sets of cosmetic DLC. Dress up like a knight from the Middle Ages with the Medieval Cosmetics Pack, or like the snake-haired Medusa with Mythology Cosmetics Pack, or release your inner Samurai or Ninja with the Shogun Cosmetics Pack.

Customise Your Monsters
Show off your monster bling with the new customisation options. Craft your perfect looking monster by choosing their facial features, colour, horns, helmet, armour, car and more. Each monster you unlock can have their own look!

Coming Soon…
To make playing with friends even easier we’re working on a new Party Mode so you and your friends can play online with other players. Also watch out for the new shark-infested, pirate-themed Skull Island track coming to the track roster soon.

See you on the race track!

notes.title: Steer Clear of Trouble Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=KvTPFqj2xXw;full][/previewyoutube]
In Monster Racing League your monster does the driving… but now you can fine tune your position on the track to steer clear of obstacles or line up the perfect mallet smash or saw blade shot. 

Along with this update we’ve updated how junctions work. Now all you need to do is steer into the side road you want to take. New striped markings on the road will help you see where you need to steer to take the side road. 

Here are the other changes:

 Doing an emote is now only one key or d-pad press away. You can also now choose your top four emotes to use from the new options in Game Settings.
 Don’t want to see player’s nametags when racing? No problem, just turn them off in the Game Settings.
 Updated controls: Use Left and Right arrow keys on keyboard or the left analog stick on game controller to make steering adjustments and take junctions.
 New hooter sound for when it’s the final lap.
 Minor updates to all tracks to reduce the number of off-track obstacles that cause crashes.
 Saw booster range increased.
 Many other minor updates and fixes.

So what are you waiting for? Get into a race and duck and weave your way to glory! We’d love to hear how you find it.

notes.title: Take Me To Your Leader! Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43189054/6717bd5f62331020d0da6fd16c2ebac934ec3d19.png

In this update we’ve added weekly, per-match and all-time leaderboards, optimised networking and made a bunch of other sweet tweaks and additions.

Here are the changes:

 New Leaderboards: There are now weekly, per-match and all-time leaderboards so you can see how well you're racing online. The weekly leaderboard shows the top monsters for the week, while the per-match and all-time leaderboards will show you who's the king monster of the hill for each match and the overall best monster racers.
 Networking: Reduced networking bandwidth by another 50%. You should experience better ping times and even smoother games online. We've now reduced our bandwidth to about 25% of what it was in our first release.
 Player Data: Our monster cloud uses improved player authentication which means leaderboards can show you and your rivals in all of their monster glory on the leaderboards!
 Car Paint Jobs: During the race your cars now use colours from your monster for a more personalised look.
 Heavily optimised cars on the server and client.
 Added new fog and car trail effects.
 Fixed missile tracking issue near junctions.
 Updated game engine and networking.
 Heaps of other minor updates and fixes.


What are you waiting for? Play some matches online and get yourself onto the leaderboards. We’d love to see how well you're racing!

notes.title: Hit the Brakes! Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43189054/5a4a19190f698d85cb503b773a61bbcd582b607e.png

In this update we’ve added braking, made it easier to invite your friends into a game and made a host of other tweaks and additions.

Here are the changes:

 Brakes: Now you can use the Down Arrow key to slow down your car - perfect for lining up Shoves and Shockwaves or dodging certain attacks. You may find other creative uses for it too!
 Invites: We’ve made it easier to invite your friends into a hosted game. Click the new Invite Friends button from the Host a Game lobby, or invite people directly from your friends list in Steam. Your friends list will also now show what screen or race you or your friends are in.
 Abilities: Shoves have increased range - bam! Missile and Saw speeds have been updated and targeting for Swaps has been refined so you won't swap with cars beside you and only slightly ahead of you. You’ll also no longer get affected by Missiles, Saws or EMPs when you’re respawning.
 Effects: We’ve added effects to the Shield when it successfully blocks an attack, as well as unique explosions for Missiles and Mines when they expire and self-explode.
 Cameras: The cameras used in races are now dynamic and move throughout a race to help with visibility and letting you know when a junction is coming up.
 Hazards: It was a bit hard to spot mud hazards on some of the tracks, so we’ve increased the contrast of them.
 Armour: We’ve improved the way armour deforms with the monster’s movement.
 Match points: The amount of points you receive for a race has been increased to a maximum of 100 points for first place.
 Many other minor updates and fixes.


What are you waiting for? Get into a race, equip Shove and try out the new Brake feature! We’d love to hear how you find it.

notes.title: Performance & AI Bots Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=LqVQzdGa7Rs;full][/previewyoutube]

Greetings fellow monster racers! In this first update we've focussed on improving network performance and the difficulty of the AI bots.

Here are the changes:

 Improved AI Bots: Bots now pick smarter ability and booster loadouts meaning hard bots are much more competitive. Winning a race is no walkover! 
 Bot Personalities: We've also given unique looks for bots on the higher difficulty levels. If you're a OG player you'll see some familiar faces, as well as some new ones. Watch out for the T-1001!
 Networking: Reduced networking bandwidth by about 25%. You should experience less network-related hitches.
 In online matches the lobby now fills out straight away so you can see who you're racing against faster.
 Smoothed cameras, projectiles and crashes.
 Quality of life updates to the UI.
 Better matching of players in the same region.
 Many other minor bug and performance fixes.


See you on the race track, monsters!
